scope: Scoped torso-rig experiment, not a complete motion release

issues.originalSymptom: Missing anticipation flexion / flight extension / landing flexion
issues.sweep30EvidenceOrExclusion: Jump phase performance is outside this supported sweep; no jump requalification.
Sweeping hip/ankle surfaces inspected in16clay images. Airborne deformation remains untested.

issues.originalSymptom: Crotch remains about14px high during crouch/impact
issues.sweep30EvidenceOrExclusion: Both displayed paws fixed and lower-body accommodation tested; jump crouch/impact trajectories remain untested.

issues.originalSymptom: Landing poyon excludes thighs or introduces a second bounce
issues.sweep30EvidenceOrExclusion: No landing/poyon authored; quiet sweep preparation/return only.
Paw shape/orientation preserved; no takeoff tested.

issues.originalSymptom: Apex soles too horizontal; descent flattens too early
issues.sweep30EvidenceOrExclusion: No airborne sole orientation or landing flattening tested.

issues.originalSymptom: Arms small in crouch/impact but not apex
issues.sweep30EvidenceOrExclusion: Existing arm material dimensions and authored local articulation retained; jump arm scaling untested.

issues.originalSymptom: Club-arm shape, stable shoulder attachment and side coherence
issues.sweep30EvidenceOrExclusion: 57native times verify rigid chest-bound shoulder/arm transport; seven four-view keys and edits reviewed. Existing root overlap remains.

issues.originalSymptom: Tail launch arc too high despite close apex
issues.sweep30EvidenceOrExclusion: Tail has explicit lower-frame rigid transport and retained shape; no launch arc or general tail dynamics tested.

issues.originalSymptom: Charcoal tail merges with charcoal limbs
issues.sweep30EvidenceOrExclusion: Inherited Sweep25 pigments retained; visible overlap reviewed in color and geometry in isolated clay. No alternate diagnostic-color identity pass.

issues.originalSymptom: Event order and timing remain coarse
issues.sweep30EvidenceOrExclusion: One authored4s preparation/sweep/return is inspected; no measured source fit or full performance acceptance.

issues.originalSymptom: AI pads, proportion drift, hidden depth and source ambiguity
issues.sweep30EvidenceOrExclusion: Independent generated views and invented tail appearance excluded as anatomy authority; exact source25rest/face retained.

issues.originalSymptom: Native parity mistaken for quality; export and ranges uncertain
issues.sweep30EvidenceOrExclusion: Native saved/reopened with scripts disabled and actual controls edited/restored; target runtime export and whole control box untested.

issues.originalSymptom: Quality claims passed despite visible failures
issues.sweep30EvidenceOrExclusion: Geometry checks separated from main-agent visual findings; no independent sign-off or all-gate completion claim.

issues.originalSymptom: One jump mistaken for a general rig
issues.sweep30EvidenceOrExclusion: One asymmetric supported reach, alternate control values and A/B ablations only; alternating support and general motion trajectories remain untested.
